name: The Billionaire’s Revenge
original_name: ดับแค้นมหาเศรษฐี
overview: On his wedding day, Ian was humiliated by his mother-in-law, who demanded an extra million in dowry. Unable to bear the insult, he called off the wedding on the spot and walked away. No sooner had he reached the ground floor than he received a notification that 100 million had been credited to his account. Suddenly, Sarah appeared and revealed a shocking secret to Ian: he was the heir to the Sterling Family, the wealthiest family in the world! Relying on his unimaginable wealth, Ian began a perilous yet incredibly satisfying journey of revenge.
